capabilities: Browse a lazy Google Drive tree without downloading files
Selectively sync chosen folders and files for offline use
Automatically push and pull edits between the vault and Drive
Open Google Docs, Sheets and Slides as clickable link notes
Trash or locally free space for synced files with confirmation safeguards
extras: Free during beta with a paid subscription (~1–2 €/month) planned; a free tier is intended to remain. Authentication goes through a hosted Real-IT broker rather than an embedded Google client secret; users can instead plug in their own Google Cloud credentials. Beta install is via BRAT, and the plugin is not staff-reviewed by Obsidian.
intentEvidence: Google Drive's official desktop app keeps your files in sync on macOS/Windows, but there is no such thing on iOS.
motivation: The author built it because Google Drive's official desktop app only covers macOS/Windows and "there is no such thing on iOS", so Drive content was unreachable from Obsidian on mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reach Google Drive files, and Google's own desktop app does not cover iOS, so mobile vaults cannot pull Drive content.

relations.evidence: Google Drive API (googleapis.com) — to list, download and upload the files you choose to sync.

summary: Google Drive client that browses your Drive in a side panel, downloads selected files on demand into the vault, and keeps both directions in sync.
